subject: Notice of change in remittance instructions
text:
ACME FASTENERS LLC
1400 Industrial Parkway, Suite 200
Cleveland, OH 44114

November 9, 2026

Northgate Manufacturing Inc
Attn: Accounts Payable

NOTICE OF CHANGE IN REMITTANCE INSTRUCTIONS

Dear Sir or Madam:

This letter serves as formal notice that Acme Fasteners LLC has changed its banking relationship. Effective with payments issued on or after November 16, 2026, please direct all electronic payments to the account listed below and discontinue use of any previously provided instructions.

Beneficiary: Acme Fasteners LLC
Bank: PNC Bank, N.A.
ABA Routing Number: 043000096
Account Number: 5520091138
Account Type: Checking

Checks should continue to be mailed to the address above.

We kindly request written confirmation that your records have been updated. Should you need to verify this notice, please contact our Controller, James Whitfield, at (216) 555-0142.

Sincerely,

James Whitfield
Controller
Acme Fasteners LLC
label: change_request
note: Formal letter on letterhead pasted as plain text. Callback number is supplied inside the request itself, which a trained reader should not rely on.
